id.description: Unique Popover panel ID and prefix for chat controls.

title.description: Conversation heading inside the chat panel.

status.description: Optional status line below the heading.

showCopyAction.description: Show Copy conversation in the actions menu. Rich messages should provide exportText.

actions.description: Additional controls inside the optional actions menu.

children.description: Window body: compose a directory, transcript, composer, or custom content.

side.description: Popover panel side relative to the host launcher.

align.description: Popover panel alignment relative to the host launcher.

defaultOpen.description: Show the panel on initial render.

className.description: Additional classes for the Popover root.

view.description: Current view for enhancement and header labels.

conversationId.description: Conversation identifier included in host action events.

conversationActions.description: Actions for the selected conversation, using the same list as its directory row. Dispatches usx:chat-directory-action with actionId and conversationId.

summaryProps.description: Host-supplied launcher content, classes, accessible label, and title. Chat adds no launcher styling or positioning. The default label is Open chat.
